description: Get ads. Common FieldNames: Id, AdGroupId, CampaignId, Status, State, Type, StatusClarification, TextAd, DynamicTextAd, MobileAppAd, CpmBannerAdBuilderAd, SmartAdBuilderAd. Use TextAd field to get ad texts. Use when the user wants to read ads, their texts, and moderation status. Do not use it to change an ad; call update_ads. Do not use it to send ads to moderation; call moderate_ads.
